children: Thakkar joins Reliance Industries after senior finance roles across real estate and hospitality, with experience spanning accounting, controls, governance and business finance

Reliance Industries has appointed Vivek Thakkar as Vice President, Accounts and Finance, marking his move into a senior finance role at the conglomerate in September 2026. A Chartered Accountant, Thakkar brings experience across real estate, hospitality, corporate accounting, governance and business finance, having previously held finance leadership roles at The House of Abhinandan Lodha, K Raheja Corp and Panoramic Universal.

Thakkar announced the move in a professional update, describing the appointment as the next phase of his finance career. In his new role, he is expected to draw on experience across financial leadership, business partnering, governance and value creation.
The appointment follows a career largely built around finance operations, reporting, controls and commercial decision-making across businesses with significant asset and operating complexity.
Before joining Reliance Industries, Thakkar served as Finance Controller at The House of Abhinandan Lodha, where he had been associated with the organisation since September 2022.

Prior to that, he was General Manager, Corporate Accounts, Commercial Estate and REIT at K Raheja Corp from March 2019 to September 2022. His responsibilities included RERA compliance, residential accounting processes and controls, Ind AS reporting, REIT accounting, mergers and acquisitions, business combination accounting and shared services.

Thakkar previously spent more than five years with Panoramic Universal, holding multiple senior finance positions. He served as Vice President, Accounts and Finance from June 2017 to August 2018, after earlier working as Assistant Vice President, Accounts and Finance and General Manager, Accounts and Finance.
He also worked as a Tax and Accounts Consultant with Vivek Thakkar and Co before moving into broader corporate finance assignments.

Thakkar is a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, with a background in business finance. His career has covered accounting, compliance, financial controls, reporting and leadership across real estate and hospitality-linked businesses.

The Reliance Industries appointment broadens his finance mandate after more than a decade in senior accounting and finance roles and adds experience within a large diversified corporate environment to his career.
